item: The Wikidata election snapshot states its age, and one older than 90 days says so in the Agenda and the coverage report
refs: PR #2221; docket row 258; 0.6 gate row A; brief S06-04 S1; V1-3
summary: A year-old configs/elections_snapshot.json read like a fresh one, and elections called since its date were silently missing. with_snapshot now carries age_days and stale (past 90 days, or dated after today); the Agenda draws the age in the caveat colour (x12) and the report says it; a registry entry watches the operator-built file with a new max_age_days window that ages it the same way, and a test runs both on one file and day. Opus read: the first month window disagreed for up to 31 days (fixed).
